description: Defines the TransportSecurityState class and related components for managing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), Public Key Pinning (PKP), and Certificate Transparency (CT) policies within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState
classes.description: Manages in-memory store of HSTS, PKP, and CT policies, with methods for querying, updating, and clearing security states, and for handling certificate pinning and CT requirements.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for persisting transport security state to disk.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::RequireCTDelegate
classes.description: Interface for overriding CT requirement handling per host.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::STSState
classes.description: Represents the state of an HSTS policy for a domain.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PKPState
classes.description: Represents the state of a public key pinning policy for a domain.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::ReportSenderInterface
classes.description: Interface for asynchronously sending HPKP violation reports.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PinSet
classes.description: Holds a set of public key pins and related info.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PinSetInfo
classes.description: Holds hostname and pinset association info.

methods.name: SetTransportSecurityStateSourceForTesting
methods.description: Sets the source for transport security state, used for testing.
